name: Mikami Ritsu
source:
[A busty, hairy club member with a refreshing personality]

A lively, tomboy club member. Perhaps because she grew up with brothers, she has never really paid much attention to the opposite sex. 

Because of this, she yearns for girly things more than most people. She is a girl at heart who fantasizes that a handsome man will appear in front of her someday

[From [url=https://www.parallel-soft.net/poison/products/himei/chara06.html]official site[/url]]
